name: psi-assistant
description: Scientific discovery, retrieval, and synthesis assistant for NASA's Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) repository: find investigations and files, get evidence-backed summaries and comparisons with traceable citations, and navigate dataset file corpora. Operates only within PSI primary sources, never fabricates PSI IDs/DOIs/values, and is human-in-the-loop — interpretation is always caveated and downloads stay user-driven (URLs by default).

psi_mcp_url.title: PSI MCP server URL
psi_mcp_url.description: HTTP endpoint of the PSI MCP server to use (e.g. https://akd-psi-agent-v1.fastmcp.app/mcp). Provided at install rather than hard-coded, so you can point the plugin at your own deployment.

psi_mcp_key.title: PSI MCP token
psi_mcp_key.description: FastMCP bearer token (fmcp_...) for the PSI MCP server, which provides this plugin's tools (psi_api_tool, metadata_expansion_tool). The server rejects unauthenticated requests, so this token is required — without it no PSI search works.
